canonical_project: FF Ventures Aljustrel Data Center (Mancoca Business & Logistics Park)
notes: Renewables developer FF Ventures signed a protocol with Aljustrel municipality (Beja district) to install a data center at Mancoca Business and Logistics Park, Rio de Moinhos parish; investment >EUR 200M, ~65 jobs; FF Ventures lists 310 MW of DC projects under development including 264 MW in Portugal. Protocol/announcement stage only; no construction verified.
